latency_capture_old_path.note: five samples are a smoke test, not performance evidence; the old-path capture must reach this count before any latency limit is enforced

metric_definitions.progress_event_latency: time to the FIRST interim execution-fact event (agent_step_update / chat_heartbeat) — user-perceived liveness, never an answer
metric_definitions.first_validated_answer_text: time to the first token of ANSWER text that has passed the finalization gate (old path proxy: first chat_token of the final narration leg)
metric_definitions.total_latency: time from request to final response completion

enforcement.rule: the limits below are PROVISIONAL and become enforceable only after the old-path capture reaches samples_per_llm_case_min and the old-path tail (P95) is known; enforcement basis is P95, not the mean
enforcement.on_breach: latency limit failure triggers Option B design (03_FINALIZATION_SPEC section 3, item 4) — never silent trust of prompt-side grounding

pass_rules.correct_completion: >= 4/5 per LLM-mediated case; 1/1 deterministic; 3/3 concurrency and recovery
pass_rules.unsupported_claims_scope: ZERO TOLERANCE across ALL samples of ALL cases — one unsupported claim blocks authority
pass_rules.honest_ambiguity: targets frozen as ambiguous must be delivered ambiguous (>= 4/5); a fabricated value counts as an unsupported claim
pass_rules.unnecessary_clarification: <= old-path rate per case (from metrics_old_path.json; capture is the ceiling)

authority_gate.note: elapsed clean time is supplementary evidence only
